statement.ru: Чтобы сделать винные пробки, пробковый дуб приходится срубить.
statement.en: To make wine corks, the cork oak has to be cut down.

why: Cork is stripped from the living tree every 9 to 12 years; the tree is not felled.

statement.ru: Бутылку шампанского можно открыть ударом сабли.
statement.en: A bottle of champagne can be opened with a blow of a sabre.

why: Sabrage: striking the neck with a sword opens the bottle, a ceremonial custom.

statement.ru: Текилу делают из кактуса.
statement.en: Tequila is made from a cactus.

why: Tequila is made from the blue agave, which is not a cactus.

statement.ru: Слово «алкоголь» сначала означало порошок для подводки глаз.
statement.en: The word 'alcohol' first meant a powder used as eyeliner.

why: From Arabic al-kuhl, kohl, a powder used as eyeliner.

statement.ru: Брют — самое сладкое шампанское.
statement.en: Brut is the sweetest kind of champagne.

why: Brut is dry (under 12 g sugar per litre); doux is the sweetest.

statement.ru: Британским морякам выдавали ежедневную порцию рома до 1970 года.
statement.en: British sailors were given a daily ration of rum until 1970.

why: The Royal Navy rum ration ended on 31 July 1970, Black Tot Day.

statement.ru: В бутылке настоящей текилы обязательно плавает червяк.
statement.en: A bottle of real tequila always has a worm in it.

why: The tequila council forbids worms; only some mezcals have one, as a marketing gimmick.

statement.ru: В бокале пива Guinness пузырьки у стенок опускаются вниз.
statement.en: In a glass of Guinness, the bubbles by the sides sink downwards.

why: The rising bubbles in the centre create a downward current along the walls of a pint glass.

statement.ru: Перри — это сидр, только из вишни.
statement.en: Perry is like cider, only made from cherries.

why: Perry, also sold as pear cider, is made from fermented pears.

statement.ru: Застольный тост назвали в честь поджаренного хлеба.
statement.en: The drinking toast is named after a piece of toasted bread.

why: The word comes from the old custom of flavouring drinks with spiced toast.

statement.ru: Японское сакэ по способу изготовления ближе к вину, чем к пиву.
statement.en: Japanese sake is made in a way closer to wine than to beer.

why: Sake is brewed from rice starch converted to sugar, a process more like beer.

statement.ru: Джин-тоник придумали британцы в Индии, чтобы пить лекарство от малярии.
statement.en: The British in India invented the gin and tonic to take their malaria medicine.

why: Officers mixed quinine tonic with gin and sugar to make the bitter medicine palatable.

statement.ru: Шампанское делают только из белого винограда.
statement.en: Champagne is made only from white grapes.

why: Black grapes Pinot noir and Pinot meunier are main champagne grapes; blanc de noirs uses only them.

statement.ru: Полный рецепт ликёра «Шартрёз» знают только два монаха.
statement.en: Only two monks know the full recipe of Chartreuse liqueur.

why: The recipe of 130 herbs is known at any time only to the two monks who prepare it.

statement.ru: Джеймс Бонд просит свой мартини размешать, а не взбалтывать.
statement.en: James Bond asks for his martini stirred, not shaken.

why: It's the other way round: 'shaken, not stirred'.

statement.ru: Ром делают из кокосов.
statement.en: Rum is made from coconuts.

why: Rum is distilled from sugarcane molasses or sugarcane juice.

statement.ru: Грог назван по прозвищу британского адмирала.
statement.en: Grog is named after a British admiral's nickname.

why: Admiral Vernon, 'Old Grog' after his grogram coat, watered his sailors' rum.

statement.ru: Коктейль «Кир» назван в честь мэра французского города.
statement.en: The Kir cocktail is named after the mayor of a French city.

why: Félix Kir, mayor of Dijon, served white wine with blackcurrant liqueur to visitors.

statement.ru: Ирландцы пишут whisky, а шотландцы — whiskey.
statement.en: The Irish spell it 'whisky', the Scots 'whiskey'.

why: Swapped: Ireland uses 'whiskey', Scotland 'whisky'.

statement.ru: Вино мадера специально нагревают, как будто оно плывёт в тропиках.
statement.en: Madeira wine is deliberately heated, as if it were sailing through the tropics.

why: Estufagem copies the heat of old tropical voyages that improved the wine.

statement.ru: Коктейль «Беллини» назван в честь композитора.
statement.en: The Bellini cocktail is named after a composer.

why: It is named after the painter Giovanni Bellini, not the composer Vincenzo Bellini.

statement.ru: Итальянское слово «фиаско» сначала означало бутылку в соломенной оплётке.
statement.en: The Italian word 'fiasco' first meant a straw-covered bottle.

why: A fiasco is the traditional round, straw-covered Tuscan wine bottle.

statement.ru: Пузырьки в шампанское закачивают из баллона, как в газировку.
statement.en: The bubbles are pumped into champagne from a gas cylinder, like soda.

why: Champagne gets its bubbles from a second fermentation inside the bottle.

statement.ru: Пиво IPA назвали так, потому что его возили в Индию.
statement.en: IPA beer got its name because it was shipped to India.

why: India pale ale was a strongly hopped ale made for export to British India.

statement.ru: Из перегонного куба виски выходит прозрачным, как вода.
statement.en: Whisky comes out of the still as clear as water.

why: The spirit is clear; its colour comes from the wooden cask.

statement.ru: Древние греки считали варварством разбавлять вино водой.
statement.en: The ancient Greeks thought it barbaric to dilute wine with water.

why: The reverse: Greeks diluted wine and thought only barbarians drank it undiluted.

statement.ru: Шумеры пили пиво через соломинку.
statement.en: The Sumerians drank beer through a straw.

why: Their straws had strainer tips to keep out the solids in unfiltered beer.

statement.ru: Кальвадос делают из винограда.
statement.en: Calvados is made from grapes.

why: Calvados is a Normandy brandy made from cider apples or pears.

statement.ru: Традицию обливать всех шампанским на пьедестале начал автогонщик.
statement.en: The tradition of spraying champagne on the podium was started by a racing driver.

why: Dan Gurney sprayed champagne after winning Le Mans in 1967.

statement.ru: Мохито придумали в Мексике.
statement.en: The mojito was invented in Mexico.

why: Havana, Cuba, is the birthplace of the mojito.

statement.ru: Древние римляне подслащивали вино сиропом, сваренным в свинцовых котлах.
statement.en: The ancient Romans sweetened wine with syrup boiled in lead pots.

why: Grape syrup was often boiled in lead pots, picking up sweet lead acetate.

statement.ru: Ледяное вино делают, добавляя в вино лёд.
statement.en: Ice wine is made by adding ice to wine.

why: It is made from grapes that froze naturally on the vine.

statement.ru: Огромные бутылки шампанского называют «Навуходоносор» и «Мафусаил».
statement.en: Huge champagne bottles are called 'Nebuchadnezzar' and 'Methuselah'.

why: Nebuchadnezzar is 15 litres and Methuselah 6 litres, named after Biblical figures.

statement.ru: Чем дольше виски стоит в закрытой бутылке, тем он становится старше и лучше.
statement.en: The longer whisky sits in a sealed bottle, the older and better it gets.

why: Whisky stops maturing once bottled; only the years in the cask count.

statement.ru: Японский тост «кампай» буквально значит «осуши бокал».
statement.en: The Japanese toast 'kanpai' literally means 'empty the glass'.

why: 乾杯 literally means 'dry the cup', like 'bottoms up'.

statement.ru: Больше всех вина в мире делает Китай.
statement.en: China makes more wine than any other country.

why: Italy, France and Spain lead; China is about fifth.

statement.ru: Некоторые дорогие сладкие вина делают из винограда, покрытого плесенью.
statement.en: Some expensive sweet wines are made from grapes covered in mould.

why: Noble rot, the fungus Botrytis cinerea, makes Tokaji and Sauternes.

statement.ru: Слово «вермут» происходит от немецкого названия полыни.
statement.en: The word 'vermouth' comes from the German name for wormwood.

why: From German Wermut, wormwood, long an ingredient of the drink.

statement.ru: По баварскому закону 1516 года пиво варили только из воды, ячменя и хмеля.
statement.en: Under a Bavarian law of 1516, beer could be brewed only from water, barley and hops.

why: The Reinheitsgebot listed only barley, hops and water; yeast was added later.

statement.ru: В Испании сидр принято наливать в стакан с высоты поднятой руки.
statement.en: In Spain cider is traditionally poured into the glass from a raised arm's height.

why: In Asturias 'escanciar' pours cider from a height to aerate it.

statement.ru: Бочка в одном немецком замке вмещает больше 200 тысяч литров вина.
statement.en: A barrel in a German castle holds over 200,000 litres of wine.

why: The Heidelberg Tun held 221,726 litres when built; about 219,000 now.
